data.name: Panel_Title
data.value: Help
data.comment: Heading of the help panel beside the SQL editor

data.name: Scripts_Title
data.value: SQL scripts

data.name: Scripts_Intro
data.value: A script is a .sql file in a script folder. The explorer lists it under Scripts; a click opens it in a SQL tab – nothing runs.

data.name: Scripts_FoldersTitle
data.value: Folders

data.name: Scripts_Folders
data.value: Your personal folder, a general one every connection sees and one per connection group – the last two are often in a shared repository.

data.name: Scripts_FoldersSettings
data.value: Set the folders

data.name: Scripts_HeaderTitle
data.value: The header

data.name: Scripts_Header
data.value: Lines starting with -- @ at the very top of the text, before any other comment or SQL and without a blank line between them; their order is free.
data.comment: Help on the header; keep -- @ as is

data.name: Scripts_Description
data.value: the description, shown in the tooltip in the explorer; several lines make several paragraphs.

data.name: Scripts_Param
data.value: the type a bind of the SQL is bound as: text, char, number, date, raw or null. Never a value.
data.comment: Follows the code -- @param name type; keep the type names as is

data.name: Scripts_ParamList
data.value: the bind stands alone in IN ( … ) and takes the values of all marked rows, one bind each.
data.comment: Follows the code -- @param name type list

data.name: Scripts_Target
data.value: the column the parameter takes its value from: the script shows in the cell menu of that column and of every column that refers to it. The table without owner.

data.name: Scripts_Unknown
data.value: Lines FerretSharp does not know are kept as they are.

data.name: Scripts_EditorTitle
data.value: In the SQL tab

data.name: Scripts_EditorSave
data.value: Saving takes the @param and @description lines typed at the top: the type goes to the variables, the description into the save dialog, and the lines leave the text. @target and unknown lines stay at the top.
data.comment: Help on the header in the SQL editor

data.name: Scripts_EditorMarks
data.value: Lines that cannot be used are marked while you type. Hover a line to see what it does – on a @target also whether the connection has its column and where the script shows.
data.comment: Help on the header in the SQL editor

data.name: Scripts_EditorComplete
data.value: After -- @ the editor suggests the header lines, the types, the binds of the SQL and the tables and columns.
data.comment: Help on the header in the SQL editor; keep -- @ as is

data.name: Scripts_CellTitle
data.value: From a cell

data.name: Scripts_Cell
data.value: The cell menu lists the scripts whose target the column reaches. A script that only reads runs at once, also on Prod; any other opens with the value filled in. A list parameter takes the values of all marked rows.
data.comment: Help on scripts in the cell menu

data.name: Scripts_SaveTitle
data.value: Saving

data.name: Scripts_Save
data.value: Save writes the tab into its file, or asks for name and folder. ● beside the title: the tab differs from its file; a change of the file on disk is reported.
